description: This header file declares cryptographic functions used in the ead module, including setting encryption keys, encrypting messages, and decrypting messages.

methods.name: ead_set_key
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic key used for subsequent encryption and decryption operations.

methods.name: ead_encrypt_message
methods.description: Encrypts a message contained in an ead_msg structure of a specified length.

methods.name: ead_decrypt_message
methods.description: Decrypts a message contained in an ead_msg structure.
